notes: Mixed-basis city: governmental funds modified cash basis (recorded as cash basis), business-type accrual. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p5); beginning/ending cash = fund balances 1,681,174 / 1,811,398 (equals total cash assets p4); 1,681,174 + 1,205,130 - 1,124,906 + 50,000 = 1,811,398. Transfers in 50,000 is the printed net total (General +53,267, Keno -3,267; Water transfers out 50,000). Business-type = Proprietary Funds total column (Water, Sewer, Sanitation); statements on p6-8; no printed single receipts/disbursements totals, so reported totals are computed from operating plus nonoperating lines (receipts 472,857; disbursements 483,563 matches Statement of Activities p2); 1,870,603 + 472,857 - 483,563 - 50,000 = 1,809,897. Depreciation and interest expense are included in disbursements. Proprietary cash flow statement (p8) recorded even though basis is cash. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position primary government total (p1), mixing modified cash and accrual. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departments combining schedule (p14-15; Library/Cemetery/Auditorium on p15), more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p9), so p9 not recorded (no budget_final for General). Cemetery spending placed under streets/highways because the statement counts it in public works (9,309 + 1,800 capital outlay shown in Capital outlay line). 'Salaries and benefits' recorded as salaries and wages. Street, Sales Tax and Keno budget schedules (p10-12) and nonmajor combining (p13) recorded; no utility fund budget schedules in trimmed PDF.
